<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="18" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="15" x2="334" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="12" x2="343" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="356" y1="18" x2="359" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="368" y="10" width="17" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="12" width="11" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="385" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- branded header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="184" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <polyline points="22,78 14,86 22,94" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="73" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
  <polygon points="195,84 202,96 198,110 189,110 185,101 188,91" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="196" cy="99" r="3" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <circle cx="365" cy="86" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".20"/>
  <circle cx="365" cy="82" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <polyline points="358,94 361,89 369,89 372,94" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <text x="195" y="143" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Add Balance</text>
  <text x="195" y="169" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#FFFFFF">Keep your Tinder experience going</text>
  <text x="195" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity=".9">Secure payments • Instant credit</text>

  <!-- main balance card -->
  <rect x="21" y="226" width="348" height="154" rx="18" fill="#000000" fill-opacity=".10"/>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="21" y="222" width="348" height="154" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="58" cy="260" r="25" fill="#FE3675" fill-opacity=".12"/>
  <polygon points="58,241 67,254 65,269 56,276 48,267 49,254" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="262" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="96" y="251" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">CURRENT BALANCE</text>
  <text x="96" y="280" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="30" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$12.50</text>
  <line x1="44" y1="303" x2="346" y2="303" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="44" y="330" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4A4A4A">Tinder Credits</text>
  <text x="346" y="330" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">125 credits</text>
  <text x="44" y="353" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Last updated today at 9:38 AM</text>

  <!-- section title -->
  <text x="22" y="414" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Choose an amount</text>
  <text x="368" y="414" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FE3675">How it works</text>

  <!-- amount options -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="432" width="106" height="70" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="75" y="460" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$10</text>
    <text x="75" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">100 credits</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="142" y="432" width="106" height="70" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="460" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$25</text>
    <text x="195" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">250 credits</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="262" y="432" width="106" height="70" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="315" y="460" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">$50</text>
    <text x="315" y="482" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">500 credits</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="57" y="444" width="36" height="17" rx="9" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="75" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">BEST</text>

  <!-- custom amount field -->
  <text x="22" y="536" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Custom amount</text>
  <rect x="22" y="548" width="216" height="45" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="39" y="577" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" fill="#939393">$  Enter amount</text>
  <text x="252" y="576" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Minimum $5</text>

  <!-- payment method -->
  <text x="22" y="625" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Payment method</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="638" width="348" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="39" y="650" width="35" height="23" rx="4" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <rect x="39" y="654" width="35" height="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="86" y="668" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#4A4A4A">•••• 4242</text>
    <text x="335" y="668" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">VISA</text>
    <polyline points="349,655 355,662 349,669" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom action above nav -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="702" width="348" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="730" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">ADD $10.00</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="765" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">By continuing, you agree to the purchase terms.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="784" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="784" x2="390" y2="784" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,802 49,794 59,802 59,814 52,814 52,806 46,806 46,814 39,814" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="49" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="808" x2="141" y2="815" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="127" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="181" y="794" width="23" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="187,810 187,815 193,810" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="188" cy="802" r="1.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="802" r="1.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="192" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FE3675">Chat</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="291" cy="800" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="291" cy="812" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="291" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="356" cy="801" r="10" fill="#FE3675" fill-opacity=".12"/>
    <polygon points="356,793 359,798 365,799 361,803 362,809 356,806 350,809 351,803 347,799 353,798" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="356" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#FE3675">Wallet</text>
  </g>
</svg>
